title: UPDATE: Van Orden Mocks AI Deepfake Order With Grok Duck

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Rep. Derrick Van Orden refused to take down synthetic campaign advertisements and instead replied to legal threats with a digitally generated animal. The Republican lawmaker in Wisconsin posted a video of a duck shouting "Cease and desist!" using the Grok AI tool after opponent Rebecca Cooke issued a demand for him to stop airing deepfakes that depict her making statements she never made.

The legal dispute over the AI-generated content is taking place in the race for Wisconsin's 3rd District. Prediction markets on Polymarket currently assign a 71% probability that the incumbent will be ousted from Congress by Cooke in the upcoming election.
